description.en: Sets up the active camera at one of several predefined match-view position presets (e.g. CAMERA_CENTER, CAMERA_MY_GOAL, CAMERA_OTHER_GOAL), initializing camera control first. Each preset's coordinates can optionally be rescaled for technique cutscenes via ToScaleWazaMap.
Preset camera position constant to use (e.g. CAMERA_CENTER, CAMERA_MY_GOAL, CAMERA_OTHER_GOAL).
Optional; when true, rescales the preset's coordinates via ToScaleWazaMap for use on a technique map (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Set the camera to the center-field preset position
CamSettingBattlePosRef(0);
